title: Migrate legacy component tokens to semantic interaction set and shadow mapper
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Background: Our component library still surface-refs multiple legacy color and shadow tokens (eg. legacy-shadow-200, btn-primary-bg-v1) that make cross-product consistency brittle and complicate runtime overrides. Goal: Replace component-specific legacy tokens with a small, semantic interaction token set (surface, elevated, action, muted, focus, ring) plus a deterministic 'shadow-mapper' that converts legacy craft shadows into a constrained physically-based elevation scale. This ticket coordinates design decisioning, token spec, and a migration PR to update React components, Storybook, and docs.

Scope: color palette mappings, typography scale adjustments for compact and default density, spacing/radius delta rules for component variants, and a shadow->elevation mapping algorithm. Excludes CSS-in-JS runtime rollout (handled by ENG-7842).
acceptance_criteria: A semantic token spec (JSON + human-readable doc) published to Confluence and added to Figma styles
Migration script that replaces legacy token references in components with semantic tokens and creates fallbacks for runtime compatibility
Shadow-mapper algorithm defined and implemented as a utility (shadow-mapper.js) with unit tests and a conversion table for legacy shadows -> elevation.{01..05}
Storybook updated: all button/table/chart stories use new tokens and visual snapshot tests updated with approved baselines
No >2% visual regressions across core console pages (manual QA + Percy/Chromatic snapshots pass or documented overrides applied)
Documentation: migration guide, change log, and code examples for the front-end SDK included in PR
Accessibility sign-off: contrast checks for new semantic colors and typographic adjustments for dense mode
comments: 2025-02-15 - Maya Chen: Kickoff meeting notes attached. Agreed to prioritize the semantic token names to decouple component semantics from color ramps. Action items: draft token list and shadow-mapper prototype.
2025-02-17 - Oliver Patel: Prototype shadow-mapper implemented. Uses ambient+direct split and clamps to five elevation steps. Early perf check shows negligible bundle size delta when tree-shaken.
2025-02-18 - PM review (Rafa Gomez): Please ensure that the migration provides runtime fallbacks so Dedicated and Private customers can pin legacy values during rollout. Added ENG-7842 as dependency.
2025-02-19 - Design review (Nina Sato): Requested that we keep a high-contrast foreground token (fg.action-strong) for small CTA states in dense tables. Added to acceptance criteria.
2025-02-20 - Engineering feedback (Alex Rivera): Suggested adding an automated codemod (jscodeshift) to handle token renames across the monorepo. I will add a codemod to PR-8345.
2025-02-21 - Maya Chen: Updated Figma styles and pushed the first draft of the migration guide: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/Token+Migration+Guide
Next steps: finish codemod, wire PR into CI snapshots, schedule QA window with growth and platform teams for 2025-03-04 to 2025-03-06.
decision_log: 2025-02-16 - Decision: Use semantic prefixes: bg.*, fg.*, border.*, action.*, ring.*, elevation.* to make intent explicit and easily overridable at runtime.
2025-02-17 - Decision: Shadow-mapper will output two CSS variables per elevation (—elev-ambient, —elev-direct) to support future renderer improvements and motion-composable shadows.
2025-02-18 - Decision: Typography scale will add a compact delta (-1 step for small form factor components) and use variable font axes for responsiveness where supported.
2025-02-19 - Decision: Spacing/radius deltas defined as scale tokens (space.0..6, radius.0..4) with explicit compact deltas and migration notes for hit-target recovery when reducing size.
